parameters.name: AuditAccountName
parameters.description: The name of the audit administrator account. > If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

parameters.name: AuditAccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the audit administrator account. > If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).

parameters.name: ExpireAfterDays
parameters.description:
The number of days for which audit logs are retained.

- 0: Logs are not retained. Automatic log expiration is disabled.

- Greater than 0: Logs are automatically deleted after N days.

- Common values: 30, 45, 90, 180, and 365.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the instance resides.
